record_links.rationale: This record explicitly teaches rearranging expressions to group like terms before simplifying.

record.evidence_quote: Sometimes expressions contain both like terms and unlike terms. To simplify an expression like this, we collect the like terms. This means we rearrange the terms first to group all the like terms together. Then we add or subtract the like terms to simplify the expression.
record.content_text: Sometimes expressions contain both like terms and unlike terms. To simplify an expression like this, we collect the like terms. This means we rearrange the terms first to group all the like terms together. Then we add or subtract the like terms to simplify the expression.

record_links.rationale: This worked example collects x terms and y terms to simplify an expression.

heading_path.h3: Worked example 10.4: Collecting like terms to simplify an expression

record.evidence_quote: Source math retained: 9x - 3y - 2y -10x + y \begin{align} &= 9x - 10x - 3y - 2y +y \\ &= -x -4y \end{align}
record.prompt_text: Simplify the expression $2x + 3y + 5x + 2y$ by collecting the like terms.
record.answer_text:
Step 1: Rearrange the terms so that you group all the like terms together.

$$
2x + 5x + 3y + 2y
$$

Step 2: Add or subtract the like terms and give the simplified expression.

$$
7x + 5y
$$

record_links.rationale: This worked example collects like terms while preserving signs.

heading_path.h3: Worked example 10.5: Collecting like terms to simplify an expression

record.evidence_quote: Source math retained: 13x +2y + 7y - 6x - x \begin{align} &= 13x - 6x - x +2y +7y \\ &= 6x + 9y \end{align}
record.prompt_text:
Simplify the expression by collecting the like terms.

$$
8x + 13y - x - 4y
$$
record.answer_text:
Step 1: Rearrange the terms so that you group all the like terms together. Keep the sign in front of each term with that term.

$$
8x - x + 13y - 4y
$$

Step 2: Add or subtract the like terms and give the simplified expression. Pay special attention to the signs of the coefficients.

Go back to Chapter 5 to revise how to add and subtract positive and negative numbers.

$$
7x + 9y
$$

record_links.rationale: This worked example collects like variable terms and constants.

heading_path.h3: Worked example 10.6: Collecting like terms to simplify an expression

record.evidence_quote: Source math retained: -2a -20b - 6a + b \begin{align} &= -2a - 6a - 20b +b \\ &= -8a-19b \end{align}
record.prompt_text:
Simplify the expression by collecting the like terms.

$$
-2x - 3y + 5 + 10x - 3 - 2y
$$
record.answer_text:
Step 1: Rearrange the terms so that you group all the like terms together. Keep the sign in front of each term with that term.

When there are constants in an expression, treat them as like terms.

$$
-2x + 10x - 3y - 2y + 5 - 3
$$

Step 2: Add or subtract the like terms and give the simplified expression. Pay special attention to the signs of the coefficients.

$$
8x - 5y + 2
$$
